notes:
Thank you for all of your feedback over the past couple of weeks on our BIG beta patch! This beta patch is a mostly Fool-centric one, with lots of reworks, changes, nerfs, buffs, and even a brand new card! There are also a few art additions and tons of bug fixes. We'll be focusing more on polishing up Dread in the future, so keep the feedback coming!

[h3]CONTENT & BALANCE:[/h3]
[b]Enemies:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed [b]Hard to Kill[/b] power: now only counts HP loss, not damage to Block (meaning this power does not work on blocked damage)
[/list]
[b]Colorless Cards:[/b]
[list]
[*]Reworked [b]My Shinies[/b] card: "Deal 1 damage for every 20(10) Gold you have." → "Deal 2(3) damage. Hits an additional time for every 25 gold you have."
[/list]
[b]Fool:[/b]
[list]
[*]The Fool's "What Am I?" Epoch now unlocks Honing instead of Quiver
[*]Added new card, [b]Optimism[/b]: Rare - Skill - Cost 1 - "Exhaust ALL Sadness in your Hand. Draw 1 card for each card Exhausted. Exhaust(no longer Exhausts)."
[*]Reworked [b]Growth[/b] card: "Exhaust ALL Sadness in your Hand. Gain 4(6) Stretch for each card Exhausted." → "Gain 8(11) Block. Transform 1 random Sadness in your hand into a copy of this card."
[*]Reworked [b]Arrow Stab[/b] card: Common - Attack - Cost 1 - "Deal 9(12) damage. If you have an Arrow, put a card that can Shoot from your Discard Pile into your Hand." → Common - Attack - Cost 2 - "Deal 13(15) damage. Gain 6(8) Aim."
[*]Reworked [b]Florescence[/b] card: Rare - Skill - Cost 0 - "Exhaust ALL of your cards that Shoot and create The Shot(+). Exhaust." → Rare - Skill - Cost 1 - "Choose a card in your hand to Transform into The Shot(+)."
[*]Reworked [b]The Shot[/b] card: "Shoot an Arrow to deal 10(13) damage for each card Exhausted by Florescence." → "Shoot an Arrow to deal 20(25) damage. Exhaust."
[*]Reworked [b]Tune[/b] card: Uncommon - Power - Cost 2(1) - "At the end of your turn, if you have a Ki Melody, the next card you play costs 0 Fool Energy." → Uncommon - Power - Cost 1 - "Whenever you gain a Ki melody, Upgrade 1(2) random card(s) in your Hand."
[*]Reworked [b]Rapid Shot[/b] card into [b]Twin Shot[/b]: Uncommon - Attack - Cost 1 - "Shoot an Arrow to deal 3 damage 3(4) times." → Common - Attack - Cost 1 - "Shoot an Arrow to deal 7(10) damage twice."
[*]Changed [b]Mythic Form[/b] card:
[list]
[*]Now has Ethereal
[*]Upgrade now loses Ethereal instead of upgrading tarot cards
[/list]
[*]Nerfed [b]Cho Ready[/b] card:
[list]
[*]Block gain decreased from 8(11) → 8(10)
[*]Aim decreased from 3(5) → 3(4)
[/list]
[*]Buffed [b]Uproot[/b] card: cost decreased from 1 → 0
[*]Changed [b]Heavy Shot[/b] card:
[list]
[*]Rarity increased from Common → Uncommon
[*]Damage decreased from 20(25) → 16(17)
[*]Aim effect increased from 2 → 3(4) times
[/list]
[*]Buffed [b]Punch of Joy[/b] card:
[list]
[*]Damage increased from 13(17) → 14(18)
[*]Sadness statuses transformed by upgrade increased from 1 → 2
[/list]
[*]Changed [b]Motif[/b] and [b]Explosive Arrows[/b] cards: swapped rarity
[*]Buffed [b]Explosive Arrows[/b] card: damage increased from 6(8) → 8(11)
[*]Nerfed [b]Lullaby[/b] card:
[list]
[*]Cost increased from 0 → 1
[*]No longer gains Innate on upgrade
[*]Block gain decreased from 20 → 12(16)
[/list]
[*]Nerfed [b]Wah Hammer[/b] card: damage decreased from 9(12) → 9(11)
[*]Nerfed [b]Repeat Shot[/b] card: damage decreased from 15(20) → 13(16)
[*]Nerfed [b]Wah Symphony[/b] card: no longer counts "Wah" cards
[*]Reworked [b]Recall[/b] card: Common - Skill - Cost 1(0) - "If the enemy is Impaled, Dislodge and put a card from your Discard Pile on top of your Draw Pile." → Common - Skill - Cost 0 - "Retain. If the enemy is Impaled, Dislodge. Exhaust. (Lose Exhaust.)"
[*]Reworked [b]Trick Shot[/b] card: "Shoot an Arrow to deal 12(15) damage and return this card to your Hand." → "Shoot an Arrow to deal 12(14) damage and draw 2(3) cards."
[*]Nerfed [b]Violent Chord[/b] card: damage decreased from 9(12) → 7(9)
[*]Reworked [b]Harmonic Shield[/b] card: "Gain 5(7) Block for each melody you have." → "Gain 4(6) block. Gain 4(6) additional block for each melody you have."
[*]Nerfed [b]Song Path[/b] card: Block gain decreased from 5(7) → 4(6)

[*]Nerfed [b]Cho Firm[/b] card: Block gain decreased from 6(8) → 5(7)

[list]
[*]Block gain increased from 7(9) → 8(10)
[*]Thorns decreased from 3(4) → 2(3)
[/list]
[*]Nerfed [b]Cho Ready[/b]: Block gain decreased from 8(11) → 7(9)
[*]Nerfed [b]Bounce[/b] card: Stretch decreased from 10(13) → 8(11)
[*]Buffed [b]Sorrowful Strike[/b] card: Sadness decreased from 2 → 1
[*]Changed [b]Archery[/b] card:
[list]
[*]Aim increased from 4(5) → 6(8)
[*]Rarity increased from Uncommon → Rare
[/list]

[*]Upgrade now increases damage from 12(13) → 12(14)

[*]Nerfed [b]Self Deprecate[/b] card: Joy decreased from 2(3) → 1(2)
[*]Nerfed [b]Ki Rest[/b] card: Energy gain decreased from 5(6) → 4(5)
[*]Buffed [b]Jest[/b] card: Block gain increased from 14(18) → 15(19)

[list]
[*]Damage and Block gain decreased from 9(12) → 8(10)

[/list]

[list]
[*]Upgrade changed from +1 Arrow → gains Innate
[*]Rarity decreased from Rare → Uncommon
[/list]
[*]Nerfed [b]Ki Verse[/b] card: no longer affects "Ki" cards
[*]Buffed [b]Show Off[/b] card: Energy cost decreased from 1 → 0

[*]Buffed [b]Honing[/b] card: "Arrows deal 50% additional damage." → "Arrows deal double damage."
[*]Nerfed [b]The Hierophant[/b] tarot card: no longer has the cost reduction

[b]General:[/b]

[/list]
